entries.title: The Lens of Meridian
entries.text: Before the Night of Eight Edges there was one world and one lamp. The Lens of Meridian sat in the Observatory and bent every possible way of living into a single steady day. Nobody remembers who ground it. Everybody remembers the light.

entries.title: The Night of Eight Edges
entries.text: The Lens did not shatter from a blow. It cracked along its own grain, eight clean edges at once, as if it had finally been asked a question it could not answer. The pieces fell outward and became places.

entries.title: Lampwrights
entries.text: A Lampwright carries a lantern tuned to the Lens. Where the lantern's light touches a shard, the shard remembers that it was part of something. That is the whole craft. The rest is walking.

entries.title: Cinder, the Shard of Struggle
entries.text: Cinder is what the Lens made of effort: a tower that rebuilds itself every time it is climbed. Those who die there wake at the foot of the stairs, a little more themselves and a little less afraid of the flame.

entries.title: Verdant, the Shard of Wandering
entries.text: Verdant is the Lens remembering roads. Its towns keep ledgers of favours owed, and its ruins keep ledgers of favours never repaid. Everyone you meet is on their way to or from something.

entries.title: Umbra, the Shard of Dread
entries.text: Umbra is the dark between the Lens's rays. It is not evil. It is attentive. It notices where you walk, what you touch and what you were too afraid to look at, and it learns.

entries.title: Slipstream, the Shard of Velocity
entries.text: A salt flat so wide the horizon curves. The Lens remembered speed here, and the remembering took the shape of cars that cannot stop dreaming of the next corner.

entries.title: Concord, the Shard of Order
entries.text: Four houses share the map of Concord and none of them share a calendar. The Lens made it to show that a border is just an argument that has not finished yet.

entries.title: Terrace, the Shard of Making
entries.text: Terrace is soil, stone and the stubborn belief that a thing built is a thing owed. Nothing in it was given. Everything in it can be shaped.

entries.title: The Gauntlet of Masks
entries.text: In the Gauntlet every fighter wears the face of a feeling. You do not defeat them. You answer them, frame by frame, until one of you has said everything.

entries.title: The Orrery of Lights
entries.text: The Lens remembered wonder as a clockwork sky: systems wound like watches, civilisations ticking at their own speeds. A ship is just a very small question sent very far.

entries.title: The Choir Signal
entries.text: A repeating tone, eleven notes, arriving from three systems at once. When decoded it is not a message but a score. Someone on the ground is meant to be listening.

entries.title: The Listening Stones
entries.text: A ring of basalt in the high moor, each stone cut to resonate with one note. Under the ring is a stair. At the bottom of the stair, something is waiting to be asked to sing.

entries.title: The Choir Warden
entries.text: The Warden was the first thing Cinder ever built to keep a door shut. It sings while it fights. Those who learned the tune say it is a lullaby, bent out of shape by being sung for ten thousand years.

entries.title: Resonant Forging
entries.text: Alloy cast while a single sustained note is played. The metal remembers the note and rings with it forever. The houses of Concord have been at war over who may hum.

entries.title: The Stopped Clock
entries.text: A clock in a cellar that stopped at the exact second its owner stopped looking. It is still warm. Something in Umbra keeps the time on its behalf.

entries.title: The Warden of Hours
entries.text: A fighter who wears the mask of Patience, which is the cruelest mask: she waits for you to run out of your own time.

entries.title: The Chronograph
entries.text: A car that was built backwards: it finishes first and then works out how. The drivers who tame it say it feels like being forgiven in advance.

entries.title: Salt Runner Hull
entries.text: A hull design tuned to a flat white world a long way off. Light, brittle, and impossible to catch in a straight line.

entries.title: Cinder Iron
entries.text: Ore that came up from the tower in a bucket that should not have survived the climb. It holds an edge as if it were angry about something.

entries.title: The Lantern Ward
entries.text: A small, honest light. The dark in Umbra is attentive, but even attention has manners. It will not cross a flame that was lit by a debt repaid.

entries.title: Beacon Echo
entries.text: A new point of light on the night side of a world that had none. Somebody there is making something and wants to be seen from a distance.

entries.title: Envoys in Ink
entries.text: Messengers from a land of treaties. They speak in clauses. They carry no weapons but they carry a great many footnotes.
